facts.value: This program consists of 4 courses, starting with a course for beginners with no prior knowledge. The goal of this course is to acquire basic subject vocabulary and strengthen knowledge about the basic structures of the Chinese language. After this course, students should be able to conduct simple dialogues in Chinese and independently navigate typical everyday situations as well as tourist and professional/business stays in China.
